MECHANISM REFINED: sid is free because it names an s16 value that already arrives sign-extended from an lh and is used where that form is wanted; r holds a COMPUTED s32 ((a0 << 12) / 255), so narrowing it forces a truncate plus re-extension - the diff shows target passing it as `move a0,s7` where we emit sll/sra plus an extra move. Naming alone never adds a slot; only a narrowing does, and every narrowing in this body sits on a computed value.
